name: branch-keeper
description: Proactively preserve valuable product directions and continue them later from Codex or Antigravity.

interface.shortDescription: Keep valuable product directions and resume them later.
interface.longDescription: Branch Keeper proactively spots distinct product directions in Codex and Antigravity conversations, asks for confirmation, stores structured decision branches locally, and generates clean continuation prompts.
defaultPrompt: Find valuable product directions I may be overlooking.
Park these directions and record why we are not pursuing them now.
Resume this product branch with a clean continuation prompt.
